summary_ja: EADの対象エクスポージャーの残高監視及び支払方針への注意と具備すべき事項を定める。
summary_en: Requires due attention to balance monitoring and payment policies for exposures subject to EAD estimation, including ability to stop drawings and daily monitoring systems.
paragraphs: An Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach shall pay due attention to the following matters and other policies on balance monitoring and payment for exposures subject to EAD estimation: (i) having the ability and willingness to stop additional drawings where an event of default short of non-payment occurs, such as a covenant breach or a technical default event; (ii) having appropriate systems and procedures to monitor daily changes in exposure amounts, current drawn balances against commitments, and balances by obligor and by rating.
